plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} opens with "Don't take this the wrong way," which has never once helped.
{PAWN_nameDef} picks a moment when nobody can easily walk away, and stands in the doorway to make sure.
It's the third time today {PAWN_nameDef} has started this sentence. This time {PAWN_pronoun} finishes it.
{PAWN_nameDef} has clearly practiced this on the nearest wall. The wall was a better audience.
{PAWN_nameDef} starts with an apology, wanders into a complaint, and arrives, eventually, at a request.
{PAWN_nameDef} keeps it short. That's how everyone knows {PAWN_pronoun} has been chewing on it for a long time.
[trait:Brawler] {PAWN_nameDef} cracks {PAWN_possessive} knuckles before asking. It's just a habit. Probably.
[trait:Wimp] {PAWN_nameDef} asks from halfway behind a doorframe, ready to retreat at the first sign of a no.
[trait:Tough] {PAWN_nameDef} has a fresh gash along one arm, hasn't noticed, and wants to talk about something else entirely.
[trait:TooSmart] {PAWN_nameDef} has prepared three arguments, two rebuttals and a diagram scratched into the dirt.
[trait:Masochist] {PAWN_nameDef} seems faintly disappointed to be asking for something that would make life easier.
[trait:Undergrounder,outside] {PAWN_nameDef} squints at the open sky like it owes {PAWN_objective} money, and keeps this short so {PAWN_pronoun} can get back under a roof.
[trait:NightOwl,morning|day] {PAWN_nameDef}, awake hours before {PAWN_possessive} body agreed to it, is in no mood to dance around the subject.
[trait:Recluse] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until there's exactly one person nearby. Two would have been a crowd.
[trait:Gourmand] {PAWN_nameDef} brings it up while eyeing someone else's plate.
[trait:Psychopath] {PAWN_nameDef} asks with a pleasant smile that doesn't get anywhere near {PAWN_possessive} eyes.
[trait:Kind] {PAWN_nameDef} asks how everyone's day went first, and actually listens to the answers, before getting round to it.
[skill:Artistic] {PAWN_nameDef} sketches what {PAWN_pronoun} means on the nearest flat surface while talking. It's a good sketch, which is annoying.
[skill:Social] {PAWN_nameDef} somehow makes the request sound like it was everyone else's idea.
[skill:Shooting] {PAWN_nameDef} talks in the slow, level voice of someone who aims at things for a living.
[grieving] {PAWN_nameDef} has barely spoken since the loss. This is the first thing {PAWN_pronoun} has asked for in days.
[grieving,night] {PAWN_nameDef} can't sleep and won't say why, so {PAWN_pronoun} talks about this instead.
[hurt,afterraid] The stitches are fresh and {PAWN_nameDef} is the color of old porridge, but {PAWN_pronoun} limps over anyway.
[winter,night] The fire's down to embers and most of the colony is asleep. {PAWN_nameDef} makes the case to whoever's on watch.
[summer,hot] Flies everywhere, sweat everywhere. {PAWN_nameDef} swats at one, misses, and gets to the point.
[spring,rain] Spring mud up to the ankles. {PAWN_nameDef} tracks half of it indoors and starts talking before anyone can complain about the floor.
[spacer] {PAWN_nameDef} has drafted this on a datapad. Twice. With footnotes.
[medieval] {PAWN_nameDef} raises it the old way: on {PAWN_possessive} feet, uninvited, and loud enough to rattle the cups.
[tribal] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until the storyteller by the fire has finished, then tells a much shorter story. It ends in a request.
[doubtful] {PAWN_nameDef} asks while looking at the floor, as if the answer's already been given.
[teen] {PAWN_nameDef} says it fast, mostly to the floor, then dares anyone to make a thing of it.
[child,night] {PAWN_nameDef} is supposed to be asleep. Instead, {PAWN_pronoun} has crept out to make a request in a very loud whisper.
[old,winter] {PAWN_nameDef}'s joints predicted this cold snap three days early. They have an opinion on this matter, too.
[newcomer] {PAWN_nameDef} is still learning everyone's names, but has already worked out what's missing.
[rich] {PAWN_nameDef} has noticed the full storerooms, and noticed who isn't benefiting from them.
[trigger:raid] {PAWN_nameDef} is still holding {PAWN_possessive} weapon, knuckles white, when {PAWN_pronoun} starts talking.
[trigger:raid] The raiders are gone. Their mess isn't. {PAWN_nameDef} steps over it to make a point.
[trigger:raid,hurt] Bleeding through a fresh bandage, {PAWN_nameDef} refuses to lie down until this is said.
[trigger:death] Someone has laid a blanket over {OTHER_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} keeps straightening the corners.
[trigger:death] {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't eaten since {OTHER_nameDef} died. The bowl beside {PAWN_objective} has gone cold twice.
[trigger:death,afterraid] The raid cost the colony {OTHER_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} wants this last part done right.
[trigger:cold] {PAWN_nameDef} slept in every piece of clothing {PAWN_pronoun} owns and still woke up with numb fingers.
[trigger:cold] {PAWN_nameDef} wakes up with frost in {PAWN_possessive} eyebrows and a very short temper.
[trigger:cold,lowtech] {PAWN_nameDef} spent the night curled against the dying embers, and has the soot on {PAWN_possessive} face to prove it.
[trigger:heat] {PAWN_nameDef} tried sleeping on the bare floor because it felt cooler. It wasn't.
[trigger:heat] {PAWN_nameDef} dragged {PAWN_possessive} bedroll outside last night to escape the heat, and woke up covered in bites.
[trigger:heat,summer] By midday the air indoors shimmers. {PAWN_nameDef}, damp and furious, has a suggestion.
[trigger:floor] {PAWN_nameDef} eats standing up again, bowl balanced on one palm, and loses patience halfway through.
[trigger:floor] There's grit in {PAWN_nameDef}'s stew, and it didn't come from the kitchen.
[trigger:floor,old] {PAWN_nameDef} gets up from another meal on the floor in three slow, noisy stages.
[trigger:barracks] {PAWN_nameDef} spent half the night listening to someone talk in their sleep. About {PAWN_objective}.
[trigger:barracks] {PAWN_nameDef} was kicked awake twice in the barracks last night, both times by the same foot.
[trigger:barracks,winter] The barracks is warm, at least, the way a crowded stable is warm. {PAWN_nameDef} would trade it for a cold room with a door.
[trigger:rawfood] {PAWN_nameDef} picks a stringy bit of something raw out of {PAWN_possessive} teeth and looks around for someone to blame.
[trigger:rawfood] {PAWN_nameDef} has been chewing the same raw mouthful for a while now. It isn't getting any smaller.
[trigger:rawfood,lowmood] {PAWN_nameDef} eats raw food with the flat face of someone who has stopped expecting better.
[trigger:sick] {PAWN_nameDef} spent the night bent over a bucket, and has come out the other side with strong opinions about the kitchen.
[trigger:sick] Gray-faced and unsteady, {PAWN_nameDef} grips the doorframe with one hand and talks about the cooking.
[trigger:sick] {PAWN_nameDef} sniffs {PAWN_possessive} lunch for a long time, decides against it, and decides to say something instead.
[trigger:dark] {PAWN_nameDef} has a bruise on one shin shaped exactly like the corner of a bed.
[trigger:dark] {PAWN_nameDef} spent ten minutes feeling for {PAWN_possessive} own bed in the dark last night, and found the wall three times first.
[trigger:dark,night] It's black as pitch in {PAWN_nameDef}'s room. {PAWN_nameDef} feels {PAWN_possessive} way out of it, blinking, with a request.
[trigger:naked] {PAWN_nameDef} arrives wrapped in a blanket, with as much dignity as a blanket allows.
[trigger:naked] {PAWN_nameDef} is wearing nothing but a scowl and a strategically held pot lid.
[trigger:naked,cold] Teeth chattering, arms wrapped around not much, {PAWN_nameDef} makes the case for clothes with every goosebump.
[trigger:cabin] {PAWN_nameDef} has paced the same room so often there's nearly a groove in the floor.
[trigger:cabin] {PAWN_nameDef} has rearranged {PAWN_possessive} few belongings four times today. There's nothing left to rearrange.
[trigger:cabin,winter] Snowed in for days, {PAWN_nameDef} has started counting the cracks in the ceiling. Out loud.
[trigger:corpse] There's a body out there nobody has dealt with. {PAWN_nameDef} has been walking the long way round it for two days.
[trigger:corpse] The flies found the body before anyone buried it. {PAWN_nameDef} found the flies.
[trigger:corpse,hot] In this heat, the dead don't stay quiet for long. {PAWN_nameDef} talks with a sleeve pressed over {PAWN_possessive} nose.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} congratulated {ENVIED_nameDef} warmly, then went away and thought about it for a long time.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} has been very polite to {ENVIED_nameDef} all day, which is how everyone can tell.
[trigger:envy,trait:Jealous] {PAWN_nameDef} has said "good for {ENVIED_objective}" four times today, each time with less conviction.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} has spent a week learning new ways to do old things, and is tired of being clever about it.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} keeps forgetting about the missing {SUBJECT}, then remembering again, all day long.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} watches the others work for a while with a look that's hard to name. Then {PAWN_pronoun} gets up, awkwardly, and asks.
{FOR_nameDef} doesn't say anything at first, which, for {FOR_nameDef}, is saying a lot.
{FOR_nameDef} takes it in quietly, then goes off to tell someone who already knows.
{FOR_nameDef} says thank you twice: once to the council, and once, under {FOR_possessive} breath, to nobody in particular.
Someone catches {FOR_nameDef} grinning when {FOR_pronoun} thinks nobody is looking.
[trait:Greedy] {FOR_nameDef} is pleased, and already visibly drafting the next request.
[trait:Jealous] {FOR_nameDef} makes sure everyone notices, especially the ones who got theirs first.
[trait:Ascetic] {FOR_nameDef} seems almost embarrassed to be given anything, and thanks everyone a little too quickly.
[trigger:raid] {FOR_nameDef} sleeps through the night for the first time since the attack.
[trigger:death] {FOR_nameDef} stays by the grave long after the others have drifted back to work.
[trigger:cold] That night {FOR_nameDef} sleeps with {FOR_possessive} feet sticking out from under the blanket, just because {FOR_pronoun} can.
[trigger:naked] {FOR_nameDef} gets dressed slowly and with tremendous dignity, as if the whole colony hadn't already seen everything.
[trigger:floor] {FOR_nameDef} eats the first meal at the new table slowly, elbows out, like a person with somewhere to be.
[promised] {FOR_nameDef} finds whoever made the promise and nods once. That's the whole conversation, and it's enough.
[petition] The ones who asked for it congratulate each other as though they'd done the work themselves.
[forother] {FOR_nameDef} finds {PAWN_nameDef} afterwards, and neither of them quite knows what to say.
[lowmood] For the first time in days, {FOR_nameDef}'s shoulders come down from around {FOR_possessive} ears.
[child] {FOR_nameDef} tells everyone, then tells the animals, then comes back and tells everyone again.
[repeat] It took asking more than once. {FOR_nameDef} decides, generously, not to mention it.
I'm not saying {ENVIED_nameDef} didn't deserve it. I'm saying I noticed.
[trait:Jealous] I watched {ENVIED_nameDef} unpack it. I watched the whole thing.

warm.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} was so pleased, and I thought, I'd like to feel that too.
I hope this doesn't sound petty. {ENVIED_nameDef}'s good luck made me notice what I've been doing without.

blunt.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} got one. {ENVIED_nameDef} is not special.
If {ENVIED_nameDef} can have one, so can I. That's just math.

cheerful.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} showed it off to me and now I can't stop thinking about it!
Seeing {ENVIED_nameDef}'s face light up was great! I want my face to do that!

gloomy.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} has one now. I've been trying not to think about it. It isn't working.
Some people ask once and get it. I'll ask anyway. I'm used to the other answer.

cold.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} has one. Allocations should be consistent.
I don't object to what {ENVIED_nameDef} received. I object to being the exception.

plain.li: All right, then; I'll stop bringing it up.
Good, that's one thing off my mind and onto yours.

warm.li: Thank you, and don't worry, I know there's a lot to do first.
You didn't have to promise, and you did; that counts for a lot.

blunt.li: Good, now I've got witnesses.
You said it out loud, so it counts.

cheerful.li: Promised, promised, I heard it, everybody heard it!
I'm going to be insufferable about this until it happens, just so you know!

gloomy.li: I'll try to believe you; it's been a while since I believed anyone.
A promise is better than a no, I suppose, until it isn't.

cold.li: I've made a note of the date you promised.
Good; I'll consider the matter scheduled.

plain.li: Right, well, I'll stop hoping, then.
Fair enough; I've lived without worse.

warm.li: I understand; there are people here who need things more than I do.
No hard feelings, truly; you've got a whole colony to think about.

blunt.li: Fine, and the next time you ask me for a double shift, the answer's the same.
Wow, you didn't even let me finish the sentence.

cheerful.li: That's a no, but it's a polite no, and I'll take a polite no!
Well, my hopes were up, and now they're having a lie-down!

gloomy.li: Figures; I'd already started being disappointed in advance.
That's fine; I'll add it to the list of things I'm not getting.

cold.li: Very well, then this colony gets one less favor from me.
A clear answer, which is more than most people give.

plain.li: {WISH}: still on my mind, still not done.
[repeat] Yes, this again: {WISH}.

warm.li: Sorry to bring it up again; I know everyone's busy, I just still think about it.
Whenever there's a quiet day, I'm still hoping, that's all.

blunt.li: I'm going to keep saying it until somebody does it.
Am I talking to myself here, or is someone writing this down?

cheerful.li: Hi, it's me, the one who asked for the thing, still asking!
Just popping by to keep the dream alive!

gloomy.li: I keep mentioning it, and it keeps not happening, and here we are.
I'm sure it's on a list somewhere, near the bottom.

cold.li: I'm raising this again because it has not been resolved.
Every day this waits, it costs a little more goodwill.

plain.li: I'm nearly out of patience, and I don't have a spare.
After this, I stop asking and start doing without.

warm.li: I've tried so hard not to be a bother, but I need you to hear me on this one.
I'm not angry yet, and I'd really like to keep it that way.

blunt.li: Last time I ask nicely; next time I just take it personally.
Clock's running out, and so is my good nature, such as it was.

cheerful.li: My smile is still on, but it's getting very tired!
I'm still cheerful, technically, but it's the kind of cheerful that throws things!

gloomy.li: I knew it would come to this; it always does.
Soon I'll stop asking, and nobody will even notice the quiet.

cold.li: Consider this formal notice.
After this, I'll stop asking and start making my own arrangements.

plain.li: Took me an afternoon, which is less time than I spent waiting.
It's not pretty, but it's done, and nobody had to approve it.

warm.li: I hope you don't mind. I didn't want anyone else to have to stop what they were doing.
I managed on my own, so please, don't feel bad about it.

blunt.li: Turns out I didn't need any of you, which is good to know.
Done. You can thank me by not asking how.

cheerful.li: I fixed it myself and honestly I've never felt more competent!
Turns out I'm handy! Who knew? Not me!

gloomy.li: Nobody was coming, so I stopped waiting for them.
I did it myself, and it's worse than if someone had helped, and I'm used to that.

cold.li: The council's delay was noted, and bypassed.
I solved the problem. The council may consider itself unnecessary in this instance.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} got theirs, and I'm still waiting on mine.
I suppose I'll keep waiting while everyone else gets served first.

warm.li: I'm happy for {OTHER_nameDef}, I really am, it just stings a little.
{OTHER_nameDef} needed it, I'm sure; mine can wait a while longer.

blunt.li: So that's the order now: {OTHER_nameDef} first, me never.
I asked before {OTHER_nameDef} did, and everyone here knows it.

cheerful.li: Yay for {OTHER_nameDef}, and a gentle boo for the rest of the queue!
I'm cheering for {OTHER_nameDef} with one hand and pointing at myself with the other!

gloomy.li: I'm used to being skipped; it doesn't stop it hurting.
{OTHER_nameDef} got lucky, and I got older.

cold.li: So {OTHER_nameDef}'s request outranks mine, and I'll remember the ranking.
Seniority means nothing here, then; useful to know.

plain.li: You looked me in the eye and promised, and I believed you.
I'll never take a promise from this council at face value again.

warm.li: I kept telling the others you'd come through, and now I look like a fool.
I'm not going to shout; I just want you to know it hurt.

blunt.li: Next time, don't promise, just say no, it's quicker.
Your promises are worth exactly what I paid for them, which was nothing.

cheerful.li: Well, that's the last time I get excited about a promise!
Lesson learned, and wow, it was an expensive one!

gloomy.li: Should have known; promises out here rot faster than meat.
I let myself hope, which was my mistake, not yours.

cold.li: Your promise has been reclassified as a lie.
I won't make the mistake of relying on your word again.

plain.li: Another council meeting, another round of nodding and nothing.
I stopped asking for things around the time I stopped expecting them.

warm.li: I keep trying to see the best in this place, and it keeps making that difficult.
I'm not angry anymore, just tired of hoping.

blunt.li: I'd get better answers from the livestock.
The council can hear my complaints when it starts hearing anything.

cheerful.li: Hello to everyone except the council!
I've decided to love low expectations, and the council never lets me down!

gloomy.li: Whatever I want, I'll want it quietly from now on.
There's no point asking; there was never any point.

cold.li: The council has demonstrated its priorities, and I am not among them.
I've stopped investing in the council; the returns were poor.

plain.li: Find a seat {VENUE}, everyone; this might take a while.
Order, everyone, order, and that includes the back row.
[night] It's late, so let's keep it to one argument each.
[poor] Meeting's open; somebody fetch another crate to sit on.
[winter|cold] Gather in close, it's freezing, and nobody leaves until we've decided something.

warm.li: Thank you all for coming after a long day; let's be kind to each other's ideas.

blunt.li: Sit down, stop chewing, and wait your turn.

cheerful.li: Council time, my favorite part of the whole day!

gloomy.li: Well, we're all still alive, so I suppose we'd better talk about what comes next.

cold.li: This meeting will be brief, and interruptions will be remembered.

plain.li: I've wanted "{AMBITION}" for a season; I'm just glad someone finally said it out loud.
Whatever it costs, it'll cost more to keep doing without.

warm.li: If it helps even one of us sleep easier, it's worth it.
I'll help with "{AMBITION}", whichever job nobody else wants.

blunt.li: It's the only idea tonight that isn't stupid, so yes.
Fine, "{AMBITION}", yes, now can we eat?

cheerful.li: I'm voting yes so hard my seat might break!
Yes, yes, a hundred times yes to "{AMBITION}"!

gloomy.li: We'll probably die anyway, but we might as well die with "{AMBITION}".
It's the least hopeless thing I've heard all night.

cold.li: Of the options, this one gets the fewest of us killed.
The numbers favor it, and I favor the numbers.

plain.li: Sounds lovely; who's paying for it, and with what?
I like it in theory, but in theory we'd have a roof that doesn't leak.

warm.li: I'm sure {OTHER_nameDef} means well, but can we really manage it right now?
Could we sleep on it before we commit to "{AMBITION}"?

blunt.li: I've heard better ideas from a boomalope, right before it exploded.
No, and if {OTHER_nameDef} keeps talking, it's still no.

cheerful.li: Ooh, a terrible idea, my favorite kind, but no!
I'd vote yes if I could work out what it actually means!

gloomy.li: Every plan we make, the Rim makes a different one.
It'll take twice as long as {OTHER_nameDef} says, and we'll be half as glad.

cold.li: Too expensive for what it returns; I've run the numbers twice.
I'll vote against it, and I'd advise {OTHER_nameDef} not to take that personally.

plain.li: Whose turn is it to wash the bowls? Because it isn't mine.
Does anyone else hear that scratching in the walls?
Somebody's foot is touching my foot, and I'd like to know whose.
[rain] The roof's dripping on me, and I'm choosing to take it personally.
[storm] Count the seconds after the flash: seven, so we're fine, probably.
[snow] Somebody's boots are melting into a puddle, and it's spreading toward me.
[cold,lowtech] Someone put another log on; I can't feel my opinions.
[night] Whoever's on watch tonight: are you on watch, or are you here?
[trait:Gourmand] Is anyone going to finish that?
[trait:NightOwl] This is the first meeting I've been properly awake for.
[trait:Jealous] Why does {OTHER_nameDef} get the good chair?
[trait:Recluse] Too many people in one room; I'll need a week alone after this.
[trait:Bloodlust] Shame we're voting; fighting about it would be quicker.
[trait:TooSmart] I've already worked out how the vote goes; I'm only here for the arguing.
[trait:Masochist] Honestly, I'm enjoying how uncomfortable this seat is.
[trait:Wimp] If anyone raises their voice, I'm leaving.
[skill:Cooking] Whoever salted the stew tonight, we need to talk after this.
[skill:Medicine] Anyone feeling feverish? You, you look feverish. Sit over there.
[skill:Mining] I found a seam of something shiny today, but sure, let's talk about this.
[skill:Plants] The crops won't harvest themselves, you know.
[skill:Shooting] Somebody's moved my weapon, and I will find out who.
[skill:Social] Three of you are lying about how you'll vote, and I know which three.
[skill:Artistic] Look at the shadows on that wall; somebody should paint this.
[skill:Intellectual] Fascinating, and I don't mean the meeting, I mean the moth on the ceiling.
[child] Why are grown-ups so loud when they agree?
[teen] Wake me up when you've decided.
[old] I've buried better councils than this one.
[grieving] There's an empty seat over there; please, nobody sit in it.
[afterraid] I still can't hear out of my left ear, so if you're voting, wave.
[hurt] Talk faster, my stitches itch.
[poor] We could sell this table and eat for a week, I'm just saying.

warm.li: Has everyone had something to eat? There's more in the pot.

blunt.li: Some of you should talk less. Most of you.

cheerful.li: I love this, everyone squashed in together, arguing!

gloomy.li: Every meeting, I count heads. One day the count will be lower.

cold.li: If this runs much longer, I'm going to start ranking all of you.
